summary.text: Mike Rice is a Democrat and former state representative who served Bennington-Rutland District from 2023 to 2025 and is seeking to return to the Vermont House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A nonprofit director who has worked in farm operations and food and agriculture policy, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include housing, health care, energy, child care and education.

paragraphs.text: Mike Rice was born in New York and has lived in Dorset, Vermont.
He earned a B.A. in English from the State University of New York at Albany in 2012 and a master's degree in food and agriculture law and policy from Vermont Law and Graduate School in 2020.
His career includes operations work for a dairy farm and creamery and work with the Northeast Organic Farming Association on regional policy and funding.
Rice served in the Vermont House of Representatives from January 4, 2023, to January 8, 2025, succeeding Linda Sullivan.
He lost the November 2024 general election to Republican Sandy Pinsonault, 54.5 percent to 45.3 percent.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Rice said he moved to Vermont in 2017 to work as a farm apprentice, and that during his term he worked on education, child care legislation, housing, prior authorization requirements and programs for small farms.
